'''Klubi i Futbollit Oriku''' is an Albanian [[association football|football]] club based in the town of [[Orikum]]. They last competed in [[Kategoria e Dytë]] during the [[2023–24 Kategoria e Dytë|2023–24 season]], finishing fourth in Group B.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Armillotta |first1=Giovanni |title=Almanacco del Calcio Albanese |date=2024 |publisher=Ledizioni srl |isbn=979-12-5600-110-1 |page=44}}</ref>"}}
